column2: A–E: same Borunte 1510A platform, axis-2 RV reducer specimens, sensor locations and acquisition chain. A–D are historical; E is an additional prospective trajectory.
Fit normalization, teachers and classifiers on A/B/C training trials only. Use A/B/C validation only for all configuration and checkpoint selection.
D and E never supply training or adaptation data in the main ABC → D/E comparison. D is previously inspected; E is assessed after model and pipeline freezing.
For each method and configuration, reuse exactly the same five checkpoints and fixed test manifests wherever that configuration is reported. Evaluating E creates no new training run.
Identical measured servo, IMU and vibration modalities; method-specific processing is fixed before target assessment. No new sensor is granted to a baseline.
Servo and IMU: 100 Hz; effective vibration: 1 kHz; fixed non-overlapping 2.0-s windows.
Class- and trajectory-balanced source sampling; final budget 100 epochs × 10 batches, batch size 60. PG-MARL uses its specified support/query inner–outer updates.
One predeclared source-only candidate protocol per method; the original six learning-rate/weight-decay pairs and 20 screening epochs. No target-based ranking; no second matched-fit group.
Every five epochs; rank by worst A/B/C validation Macro-F1, then pooled validation Macro-F1.
One source-validation-selected checkpoint per method, fixed across A/B/C/D/E; target performance never selects it.
Different configurations require their own source-trained frozen checkpoints. Equivalent settings reuse the same record. E is excluded from model development and all scans.
2,000 percentile bootstrap replicates: resample fitted runs and physical trials within class on D; resample complete five-state groups on E. Share physical resampling draws across methods.
BCD→A, ACD→B and ABD→C require separately fitted models. They are not the main ABC checkpoints; E is never a training fold.
α=1; T=4; β_init=2; λ=0.1; uniform π_c=0.2. β follows a cosine decay from β_init to zero over meta-epochs 1–100; probability distillation is absent from the query objective.

Mean of five Gaussian RBF kernels exp(−||u−v||²/(2σ_l²)); σ_l=s₀×{0.25,0.5,1,2,4}. s₀ is the median positive Euclidean distance in a fixed ≤1024-window source-training embedding subset, seed 42; frozen before D/E.

γ=2 is the student cross-entropy coefficient; all classes have equal weights. ηin=0.002 is the inner-loop SGD rate. The outer Adam rate ηout starts at 3×10−4 and is cosine-annealed to 10−5. ε=10−8 stabilizes class-conditional means, feature ratios, and log probabilities. Standardization uses only source-training statistics.
